Executive Summary

Item Result
Feature Under Test Main Layout Fullscreen: Toggling 3D WebGL viewer into full-screen mode via native HTML5 Fullscreen API (body.requestFullscreen()), dynamic button icon state switching (.vi-fullscreen vs .vi-close-fullscreen), window resize dispatching, and Babylon 3D engine camera aspect ratio synchronization on live exhibition data
Live Exhibition Tested https://gallery.villume.com/pDbChMcH (Dark Valleys)
Test Coverage White Box (Component template binding, fullscreenMode() logic, screenResize event handling), Gray Box (Browser DOM Fullscreen state transitions & Escape key cancellation), Black Box (End-to-End browser execution on live production 3D exhibition)
Automation Suite Result 4/4 Passed (100% pass rate)
Final Verdict Passed

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  1. Fullscreen API Integration & Execution on Live Data (pDbChMcH):
    • In src/app/villume-gallery/villume-gallery.component.ts (fullscreenMode(), line 1042): 
      fullscreenMode() {
  if (this.onActiveTipsClick('Fullscreen')) return;
  window.removeEventListener('resize', this.screenResize);
  if (!this.fullscreen) {
    const body = document.querySelector('body') as HTMLElement;
    body?.requestFullscreen();
    this.fullscreen = true;
  } else if (document.fullscreenElement != null) {
    document.exitFullscreen();
    this.fullscreen = false;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', this.screenResize);
}
    • Directly binds to body.requestFullscreen() and exits cleanly via document.exitFullscreen().
  2. Template Markup & Icon Toggle:
    • In src/app/villume-gallery/villume-gallery.component.html (lines 23-31):
      • Renders <button class="btn btn-circle btn-fullscreen" (click)="fullscreenMode()">
      • Dynamically swaps between <i class="vi vi-fullscreen"></i> (windowed) and <i class="vi vi-close-fullscreen"></i> (fullscreen active).
  3. Babylon 3D Engine Resize Synchronization:
    • The screenResize callback observes window dimensions and dispatches a debounced resize event after 300ms. On the live Dark Valleys exhibition, the 3D canvas viewport seamlessly recomputes aspect ratio, preserving high-resolution artwork frames, lighting, and camera positioning without scene distortion or WebGL context reset.
  4. Keyboard & Touch Accessibility:
    • Exiting via standard Escape key or by clicking the exit fullscreen button properly updates document.fullscreenElement, synchronizing the internal this.fullscreen = false flag and returning the button icon to windowed state seamlessly.

Bug notes

  • Major: #397 acceptance is not met because angular.json still uses @angular-devkit/build-angular:browser, not @angular-devkit/build-angular:application.
  • Major: legacy SSR targets remain split across server, serve-ssr, and prerender; the issue requires browser/server/SSR configuration to be merged into a single build target.
  • Major: @nguniversal/builders@13.0.2 is still installed and used, which conflicts with the requested modern esbuild application builder migration.
  • Major config bug: serve.configurations.staging.browserTarget references villume-admin:build:staging inside the gallery repo.
  • Build command passes, but this is not proof of migration because the output still uses the legacy browser bundle path.
